from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEps(BaseModel):
    """Basic earnings per share reported in one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/证券 code if provided")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="The basic earnings per share value, signed")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024 年第一季度")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 元/股")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the EPS figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_eps_entries: list[CompanyEps]
